about: The example prompts on the landing page (index.html, between <!-- prompts:start --> and <!-- prompts:end -->), with the run that produced each screenshot. Each prompt text is exactly what was sent. To change the set: run the prompt on a scratch server (scripts/prompt-bench.mjs), score it (scripts/accept.mjs), screenshot the workspace at 1440x900 with the conversation panel open (2x, WebP), then update this file and the matching tab and panel in index.html; packages/ui/test/site.test.ts fails when the two disagree.

run.server: branch build on a scratch port over a fresh OPENTERMINAL_HOME (config.yml only); connectors openbb (OpenBB Platform 5.0.0), yahoo, finnhub
